about: DS-14 golden cases (ci/golden/ds/CLAUDE.md). A case with "run": true is compared with ci/golden/ds/<id>.json by ci/golden/ds/run.cjs; "run": false is skipped and names the module it waits on. The module that lands a group writes its handler (groups/<group>.cjs), switches its cases to run and commits the expected files (UPDATE_SNAPSHOT=1). A "matrix" case expands to one case per combination (id/<a>-<b>-...).

contracts.what: ReportDoc v2 fixtures parse, their byte size, page and element outline, bindings and the check ids of their kind; an RS v1 doc upgraded

status.what: GET /studio/status per role with the studio and KPI tracking on and off, and the guard's answer (DS_STUDIO_OFF, DS_ROLE)

seed.what: the seed docs built through POST /docs (and /resize): outline, build steps, every binding and chip resolved

render.what: renderer HTML per element type, per format, per mode

parity.what: DS-2 GHG totals equal POST /user/ghg/tables (CY and FY); EDE intensity unchanged after the extraction

checks.what: the checks list of each seed doc

pdf.what: proof vs final: page count, text per page, positions within 0.5 mm; the print bleed box

ai.what: recorded provider responses per action validate (zod, token guard, binding check)
